facts.headline: February 19 2025 Daytrading Opportunities in Leveraged ETFs
facts.summary: Leveraged ETFs like SOXL, FAS, and TECL offered intraday setups on February 19, 2025, with SOXL leading pre-market volume. Beyond the day's session, this is also a plain-language look at the daily-reset math and decay that make leveraged ETFs powerful tools and poor places to stand still.
